description.value: Japanese Kitchen Kura is an authentic Japanese restaurant in the heart of Penticton, South Okanagan. The chef trained in Japan and ran an izakaya-style restaurant in Shiga Prefecture for a decade, bringing genuine Japanese culinary tradition to the region. The casual atmosphere and central Main Street location make it a natural lunch or dinner stop for cyclists passing through town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is from the business website at japanesekitchenkura.com, which confirms address (1445 Main Street, Penticton, BC), phone (778-476-1138), and that takeout is offered ('We offer take-out as well'). The menu page shows several clearly vegetarian dishes (Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Spinach Gomaae, Broccoli Gomaae). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. OSM name 'Kura' differs from the full business name 'Japanese Kitchen Kura' used throughout the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kura' but the business consistently uses 'Japanese Kitchen Kura' on its website; the OSM record may benefit from a name update.
OSM record lacks address, phone, and email tags; all contact details sourced from website only.
Website copyright reads '© 2017', suggesting it may not be actively maintained, though content and hours appear current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Authentic Japanese restaurant on Main Street in central Penticton — a proven cycling hub — with confirmed takeout service and vegetarian menu options, making it a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Spinach Gomaae, Broccoli Gomaae, Plain Sunomono Salad. No vegan or GF labeling confirmed
